schema_version.description: Schema contract version for this payload.

mode.description: Execution mode and flags describing how the job was run.

dryrun.description: Whether this run was preview-only and made no writes.

single_object.description: Whether this payload came from object-scoped reconciliation.

include_child_devices.description: Whether child-device expansion was enabled for this run.

include_interfaces.description: Whether interface expansion was enabled for this run.

execution_mode.description: Canonical execution mode used by the engine for this run.

pipeline_stage_metrics.description: Bulk-only pipeline metrics including totals and per-batch averages.

batches.description: Number of pipeline batches recorded in this report.

source_object_count_total.description: Total source objects processed across all batches.

tracking_row_count_total.description: Total tracked DNS records seen across all batches.

pending_rule_work_items_total.description: Total per-object rule evaluations queued during planning across all batches.

pending_bulk_updates_total.description: Total queued rename updates across all batches.

update_fallback_chunk_attempt_count_tota.description: Total update-path chunk fallback retries across all batches.

update_fallback_singleton_attempt_count_.description: Total update-path per-record fallback retries across all batches.

update_fallback_singleton_failure_count_.description: Total update-path per-record fallback retries that still failed.

create_fallback_chunk_attempt_count_tota.description: Total create-path chunk fallback retries across all batches.

create_fallback_singleton_attempt_count_.description: Total create-path per-record fallback retries across all batches.

create_fallback_singleton_failure_count_.description: Total create-path per-record fallback retries that still failed.

new_update_failure_state_count_total.description: Total new repeated-update failure entries created across all batches.

existing_update_failure_state_count_tota.description: Total updates to existing repeated-update failure entries.

stage_metrics.description: Cumulative elapsed seconds per pipeline stage.

fetch.description: Total seconds spent in the fetch stage.

planning.description: Total seconds spent in the planning/materialization stage.

apply.description: Total seconds spent in reconciliation apply stage.

bulk_flush.description: Total seconds spent flushing queued bulk operations.

total.description: Total end-to-end seconds across complete batch processing.

avg_per_batch.description: Per-batch averages for totals in this pipeline report.

source_object_count.description: Average source objects processed per batch.

tracking_row_count.description: Average tracked DNS records seen per batch.

pending_rule_work_items.description: Average per-object rule evaluations queued during planning per batch.

pending_bulk_updates.description: Average queued rename updates per batch.

update_fallback_chunk_attempt_count.description: Average update-path chunk fallback retries per batch.

update_fallback_singleton_attempt_count.description: Average update-path per-record fallback retries per batch.

update_fallback_singleton_failure_count.description: Average update-path per-record fallback failures per batch.

create_fallback_chunk_attempt_count.description: Average create-path chunk fallback retries per batch.

create_fallback_singleton_attempt_count.description: Average create-path per-record fallback retries per batch.

create_fallback_singleton_failure_count.description: Average create-path per-record fallback failures per batch.

new_update_failure_state_count.description: Average new repeated-update failure entries created per batch.

existing_update_failure_state_count.description: Average updates to existing repeated-update failure entries per batch.

stage_metrics.description: Per-batch average elapsed seconds per pipeline stage.

fetch.description: Average seconds spent in fetch stage per batch.

planning.description: Average seconds spent in planning stage per batch.

apply.description: Average seconds spent in apply stage per batch.

bulk_flush.description: Average seconds spent in bulk flush stage per batch.

scope.description: Target selection scope and applied filter values.

scanned_models.description: Model labels scanned while selecting targets for this run.

filters.description: Caller-provided filter values recorded in the result payload.

source_models.description: Source model labels provided by the caller as a filter.

rule_ids.description: DNS rule UUIDs provided by the caller as a filter.

location_ids.description: Location UUIDs provided by the caller as a filter.

tenant_ids.description: Tenant UUIDs provided by the caller as a filter.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of in-scope targets to process.

batch_size.description: Pipeline batch size used during processing.

execution.description: Execution counters and total runtime for this reconciliation run.

targets_selected_count.description: Number of targets selected after scope/filter evaluation.

targets_processed_count.description: Number of selected targets actually processed.

targets_succeeded_count.description: Number of processed targets without target-level failure.

targets_failed_count.description: Number of processed targets that failed at target level.

runtime_seconds.description: End-to-end runtime for this job execution in seconds.

reconciliation.description: Aggregated reconciliation outcomes and change counters.

objects_with_existing_rule_records.description: Targets that already had tracked rule records.

existing_rule_record_count.description: Total pre-existing tracked rule records seen before reconciliation.

objects_changed.description: Targets that had at least one create, delete, or update operation.

dns_record_update_count.description: DNS records updated in place during reconciliation.

dns_record_unchanged_count.description: Existing DNS records evaluated and left unchanged.

dns_record_total_count.description: Total DNS record create plus delete plus update operations.

changed_record_count.description: Total DNS records changed across create, delete, and update operations (currently equivalent to dns_record_total_count).

targets_noop_count.description: Targets evaluated with no required changes.

update_fallback_chunk_attempt_count.description: Update-path recursive chunk retries triggered by bulk flush failures.

update_fallback_singleton_attempt_count.description: Update-path per-record retries attempted after fallback switched to per-record mode.

update_fallback_singleton_failure_count.description: Update-path per-record retries that still failed.

create_fallback_chunk_attempt_count.description: Create-path recursive chunk retries triggered by batched create failures.

create_fallback_singleton_attempt_count.description: Create-path per-record retries attempted after fallback switched to per-record mode.

create_fallback_singleton_failure_count.description: Create-path per-record retries that still failed.

new_update_failure_state_count.description: New repeated-update failure entries created from failed per-record update retries.

existing_update_failure_state_count.description: Existing repeated-update failure entries updated from failed per-record update retries.
